column1: # hf_cache_manifest.tsv — the exact HuggingFace repos, revisions and files that
# make up s3://<shared>/hf-cache/hub/, the offline cache M5/M6/M9 read.
# GENERATED, NOT HAND-WRITTEN, and that distinction is load-bearing: this file was
# produced by listing a known-good seeded tree (us-west-2, 2026-09-26). A hand-typed
# list would have missed that nvidia/Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B is pinned at TWO different
# revisions — f176dc95 for tokenizer.pth and 15a82a2e for the post-trained EMA — because
# cosmos's checkpoint_db.py registers them separately. It would also have omitted the
# Qwen and google/siglip repos, which are transitive dependencies no NVIDIA doc lists.
# Revisions are PINNED SHAs, not 'main', because that is what checkpoint_db.py requests
# and an offline lookup of a different revision is a cache MISS. Four of these repos have
# no refs/main at all, so asking for 'main' fails even on a byte-perfect cache.
# Regenerate after the upstream pins move:
# 164 files, 12 (repo, revision) pairs, 61.17 GiB of snapshot payload.
